# CaniUAV — Industrial UAV Accessories & Custom R&D
> High-performance UAV components and custom engineering services by CANI Technology (长凌科技).

## Core Products

### Digital Video Transmission (/products/accessories/fpv)
1080P HD COFDM digital link, 30ms end-to-end latency, 50km range. AES-256-GCM encrypted. Ideal for BVLOS missions and power inspection.

### Gimbal & Pods (/products/accessories/gimbal)
IP67-rated tri-axis stabilized gimbals with IR + RGB dual-sensor fusion. Supports DJI PSDK and MAVLink interfaces. Operational range: -40°C to 60°C.

### High-Power VTX (/products/accessories/vtx)
Analog video transmitters from 2.5W to 37W output. Long-range line-of-sight up to 50km. Multiple frequency band options.

### Flight Controller & ESC (/products/accessories/fc-esc)
Industrial-grade FC/ESC combos with dual-redundancy IMU, DShot protocol, and programmable firmware. MIL-STD-461G EMC certified.

### ELRS Control System (/products/accessories/elrs)
ExpressLRS-based long-range control links. Sub-millisecond latency, open-source protocol, frequency-hopping spread spectrum.

### AI Vision Modules (/products/accessories/ai-module)
Edge AI modules with dual-light (visible + thermal) sensors for autonomous target tracking and defect detection.

## Custom R&D Services (/custom-research/accessories)
Full OEM/ODM engineering: PCB layout → firmware development → structural design → extreme-environment testing (-40°C to 60°C). 200+ R&D engineers. Prototype delivery in 30 days.

## Custom Drone R&D (/custom-research/drone)
150kg heavy-lift logistics platform, 30-day tethered continuous flight (500V HVDC), MAVLink 2.0 secure protocol (AES-256). CFD simulation, carbon fiber monocoque airframes, Level 8 wind resistance (17.1m/s). Full OEM/ODM from concept to mass production.

## Custom UAV Software R&D (/custom-research/software)
Industrial-grade UAV software development: custom GCS with multi-sensor 3D calibration, MAVLink protocol optimization, ≤30ms control latency. LibUtils C/C++/Python SDK. Edge AI integration (YOLOv8) for real-time defect detection. RTK/PPK cm-level positioning. Cross-platform: Windows, Android, Linux. BVLOS-compliant (Part 108/SORA). Digital twin sync with ArcGIS/BIM platforms.

## Custom Payload R&D (/custom-research/payload)
Industrial UAV payload customization: 37W high-power VTX (1080P/30ms, 50km link), EO/IR dual-sensor gimbal (≤0.1mrad stabilization, 640×512 IR thermal), PDK payload development kit. SWaP-C optimization (≤1.1kg AI+multispectral integration). MAVLink/PSDK/ELRS protocol support. RF zone EMI shielding for high-power links. IP67 protection, -20°C to +55°C. Full OEM/ODM from concept to flight calibration.

## About CANI Technology (/about)
CANI Technology (深圳市长凌科技有限公司), founded 2003 in Shenzhen, is a National High-Tech Enterprise specializing in industrial UAV core component R&D. Core products: 37W high-power VTX (1080P/30ms, 50km range), ≤0.1mrad 3-axis stabilized EO/IR gimbal (640×512 IR), industrial FC/ESC systems. 50+ patents, ISO 9001 certified. Full OEM/ODM from interface definition to system integration. Deployed in 30+ countries for power inspection, security & SAR, wildfire prevention, and BVLOS surveying missions.

## Contact & Support (/contact)
Industrial UAV payload OEM/ODM consultation, 37W VTX integration support, EO/IR gimbal tech support. 24/7 technical hotline. PDK payload development kit available. Global BVLOS remote debugging. ICD and SDK documentation provided.
